note: The stock image (Picture) page of each X50 family model, read from the stock dumps on 2026-11-14: "image" = the children of image in the model's own newsettings tree (node ids in order, a sub page as {node: [children]}), "nodes" = each node's stock entry from the same build's res raw JSONs (text = string resource, type = newsettings cell: 9 small title, 1 arrow row opening a page or list (tree openType 1 list page, 4 the BrightnessCell bottom slider with the Boost step, 5 the bottom horizontal list), 2 switch, 3 button, 7 value list (map = stock value -> text), 54 slider 0..100, 0 a dialog of its own (image_mode_vibrant_correct: VibrantCorrectDialog, a two-way slider -40..+40 = setVibrantHDRXCoeff(step / 2000), shown only while getDynamicBlackType() != 0), 20 / 26 page titles; map = the stock values and their texts; tree = the tree node's own keys). dianamax = dianapro (G0100 runs the G0111 build), dianahymax = dianahypro (H0063 runs the H0062 build). test/stock_picture.py derives the Picture section of every X50 family devices/*/menu.json from it. The X50 family trees of the XGIMI v1.3.38 newsettings (read 2026-11-21) add dynamic_black_setting, the dynamic black page, right above image_dynamic_black_bit_enhancement (both stay on screen there), Lumen offers it only on that firmware. The RS30 old line trees (athena3pro, athena3promax, athena3ultra, athena3ultramax) come from the release_838_newsettings.apk of the official v1.2.27 FULL OTA (read 2026-11-24, the same reader reproduces the athena35ultramax and athena35ultrahl entries node for node). The MIRA line trees (bollywood, bollywoodpro, oscar) come from the release_838_newsettings.apk of the official v1.3.1 FULL OTA.
